name: hud_layout_hw_update_objective_dirty_rect
description: HudLayoutHW::UpdateObjectiveDirtyRect derives the objective dirty rectangle from the objective widget image and center, invalidates layout widget2, invalidates the nanite panel, and redraws the nanite panel.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x4132b0 show objective widget image width and height reads, objective widget GetCenterX/GetCenterY virtual dispatches, dirty rect construction with right edge from g_HudUiMgrObjectiveWidgetRightX, layout widget2 InvalidateRect dispatch, nanite panel Invalidate, and nanite panel Draw.

The native HUD smoke verifies the derived dirty rectangle passed through layout widget2 InvalidateRect, center dispatch counts, layout widget invalidation, nanite invalidation, and nanite Draw dispatch.
